properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured), THE CLASS behind C1–C3 of the 2026-09-27 dev_storyflow report. Of the 8 things the root-cause skill asks an agent to record, 3 go through cleanly on the ordinary path. 1 works only by a route nobody names, 1 is routed to a heavy tool and a refusing stub, 1 no typed tool can write, and 2 have no home but prose. The only mechanical check, skill_lint, asks whether a named tool EXISTS: it counts a refusing stub as served and never reads tool descriptions or parameters
properties.statement:
STEP ⑥ OF THE TRIAGE of art:dev-storyflow-feedback-2026-09-27, run 2026-09-28. Three reported issues looked like one class: a served skill instructs a record that no served tool on the agent's path can write. They are fact:root-cause-a-check-on-a-ruling-is-modelled-as-governed-by-and-the-verifies-refusal-never-says-so-2026-09-28 (C1), fact:root-cause-a-cause-with-no-node-yet-has-a-working-deferred-route-that-no-instruction-names-2026-09-28 (C2) and fact:root-cause-repair-reached-add-change-event-in-0-68-and-no-instruction-followed-it-2026-09-28 (C3). The class was measured instead of assumed.

① THE MEASUREMENT: every write the served root-cause skill asks for, against reflow2-mcp 0.72.0 on a scratch store.

  ask (step)                                  ordinary-path tool          writable?
  ⑧ dated finding on its subject             record_finding              YES
  ⑧ CAUSES + evidence, the cause is a node   record_finding caused_by    YES
  ⑧ CAUSES, the cause is a CLASS or absence  record_finding caused_by    REFUSED ("no node with id …"). The deferred route
                                                                          (no caused_by now, create_edge CAUSES later) WORKS
                                                                          and is named nowhere (C2)
  ④⑤ the refuting measurement's verdict on   record_finding              NO. "unknown field `validation_status`". Only raw
     the cause (hypothesis/validated/refuted)                             create_edge can set it; recorded 2026-09-22 in
                                                                          fact:the-causes-edge-carries-a-full-rca-vocabulary-that-no-served-tool-can-set,
                                                                          still true today
  ⑧ repair + stands_in_for                    skill names                 MISROUTED. snapshot_before_change needs an existing
                                              snapshot_before_change      epoch and a target; add_change_event has taken both
                                                                          since v0.68.0 and is not named; repair_report's
                                                                          description names record_change, a REFUSING STUB (C3)
  ⑦ "observed it fail"                        record_finding prose        YES (prose)
  ⑥ the CLASS itself                          none                        NO HOME. Sighting ② of
                                                                          dec:idea-the-thing-you-need-to-point-at-is-usually-not-a-node-yet
  ⑨ what could not be established             none                        NO HOME. dec:idea-a-measurement-cannot-state-what-it-could-not-establish

⇒ 3 of 8 clean. 1 has a working route no instruction names. 1 is misrouted to a heavy tool and a refusing stub. 1 no typed tool can write. 2 have no structured home, and both are already open ideas. C1 is a sibling rather than a member: no skill asks for a check→ruling link, and the tool and the reader exist (GOVERNED_BY, read by choices_in_doubt) while no instruction and no typed refusal names them.

② PRECEDENT, so this is a RECURRENCE and not a new class. It is the three-legs shape. fact:vocabulary-needs-three-legs-and-a-users-project-gets-none-of-it (2026-08-18) first recorded "THE SKILL INSTRUCTS AN AGENT TO DRAW AN EDGE NO TOOL DRAWS" (SPECIFIES). fact:the-three-legs-audit-run-at-last-54-of-93-and-five-types-exist-only-in-the-schema (2026-08-26) swept it once. dec:idea-a-skill-may-assert-the-defaults-it-relies-on (2026-08-08) is the same drift one field deeper, a skill and a tool from one binary disagreeing about that binary. What those did not name is WHY it keeps recurring, which is this finding.

③ CANDIDATES for the recurrence: (a) authors forget, and nothing mechanical exists. (b) A mechanical check exists and its scope misses these shapes. (c) Each instance is a one-off with no shared cause. (d) THE OBSERVATION IS WRONG: the skill's routes work and the reporter misread them.

④ DISCRIMINATOR: if (b), a gate runs over skills-to-surface agreement, is green today, and C3's live instance (a description naming a stub) sits inside its blind spot.

⑤ RESULT. tools/skill_lint.py (ver:skill-lint) runs in CI and PASSES today ("All skill-lint checks passed"). It checks that each backticked term in a SKILL.md is a served tool, deriving "served" from #[tool] methods. record_change is still a #[tool] method, a refusing stub listed in service.rs DEPRECATED_TOOLS, so the check counts it as served. It reads NO tool description, so repair_report's "Write the disposition with `record_change`'s `repair` argument" (toolsnap, v0.67.0 through v0.72.0) is outside it, along with 7 other served mentions of record_change (assure.rs:400, built.rs:369, query.rs:817, capture.rs:702/715/717/2191, temporal_tools.rs:535). It checks NO `tool`-to-parameter pairing, and NO refused value (C2's unresolved caused_by). tools/vocabulary_reach.py judges node-property NAMES against any writer of that type, so `repair` reads reachable through either tool whichever one the instruction names. It still maps the stub record_change as a ChangeEvent writer, and its report does not cover CAUSES.validation_status (absent from its output). ⇒ (b) HOLDS. (d) is refuted for C2 and C3, where each measurement reproduced the refusal the reporter saw, and holds only for C1.

⑥ THE CLASS, stated: the agreement between what an instruction (skill, tool description, refusal text) tells an agent to write and what the ordinary-path tool accepts is kept BY HAND in several places. The one gate over it checks a coarser property: that a named tool EXISTS. So a rename (09-18), a field widened to a second tool (09-23) and a case a tool refuses (a cause with no node) all ship green. Test: would fixing this class have stopped the earlier reports? It would have failed repair_report on 2026-09-18, the day of the rename. It would not by itself have caught SPECIFIES (08-18) or validation_status (09-22), which are missing TOOLS rather than misrouted instructions. Those need the reach instrument extended to edge properties.

PINNING TEST, of the class (not written; code is out of scope): extend skill_lint so that (1) a tool in DEPRECATED_TOOLS named in any SKILL.md, served tool description or refusal string FAILS (fails today on repair_report); (2) every `tool`'s `param` pair and "`tool` takes `param`" sentence in a skill resolves against that tool's toolsnap input schema; (3) the root-cause skill's ⑧ asks are listed as data, each naming its tool, and each is asserted writable on that tool. Mutation check: renaming a tool without re-pointing its mentions must go red.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether other skills beyond root-cause carry misrouted asks (only root-cause's asks were censused); whether the 7 other record_change mentions each mislead an agent in practice; whether storyflow's sessions read tool descriptions or skills first.
